author: Ubisoft
description:
Agents, the Cleaners have arrived in Washington D.C.
 
For the first time, the notorious faction has crossed into the capital, searching for the resources needed to produce their signature Purple Flame. Fight fire with fire through new Burn-focused gameplay and open-world encounters as you push back against a growing Red Horizon.
 
This season expands the Dark Zone experience with the new Blackout Dark Zone, an uncapped PvP environment where your full build power, including Prototype Gear, can be unleashed. Plus, the fan-favorite Toxic Dark Zone joins the permanent rotation, offering a unique PvE-focused take on the Dark Zone.
 
Take on new Classified Assignments, unlock new gear, and progress through a brand-new Season Pass packed with cosmetics, gear, and more. With limited-time events, new challenges, and additional rewards arriving throughout the season, there's always a new battle waiting on the horizon.
 
The Division 2: Red Horizon launches on August 27.

About The Division 2:

author: Ubisoft
description:
Get closer to game development than ever before. Play games early, share feedback, interact with development teams, and unlock deeper access through The Player Council. 

Join. Play. Get involved. 

playercouncil.gg

The Player Council is a new platform where you will be part of the game development process, teaming up with the dev teams.

From early prototypes to major franchises, your feedback and participation will contribute to shaping the games of tomorrow. 

As Council contributor, you will play early games and prototypes, build relationships with development teams, share your feedback, and let your voice be heard.     

The Player Council is now open in Soft Launch and will regularly be enriched with new concepts, from all genres, size and franchises. Please note: The Player Council soft launches in English only for now.

Join. Play. Get involved. 

playercouncil.gg

Learn more about Ubisoft: www.ubisoftgroup.com

author: Ubisoft
description:
Welcome (back) to Erathia!  
 
From kingdom exploration, to strategic battles and heroes management, take a first look at Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake gameplay and discover how to shape your legend in one of the greatest Strategy Games, reimagined for an enhanced experience.  

Wishlist now on PC, PlayStation®5 and Xbox Series X|S: http://mightandmagic.com/HMM3R

About Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake:

Rediscover the critically acclaimed turn-based strategy classic and its two expansions faithfully rebuilt in full 3D and 4K. 

Join Queen Catherine on her crusade to restore order to the kingdom of Erathia, torn apart by her father's assassination and the onslaught of invading factions. Explore a vibrant fantasy world, build spectacular towns, and lead mighty heroes in epic, tactical battles.

A legend reborn. The legacy continues.

Learn more about Ubisoft: www.ubisoftgroup.com
